Argentina defeats Egypt in World Cup match; coach makes political statement

Argentina defeated Egypt 3-2 in a FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16 match. Egypt's coach, Hossam Hassan, stated before the match that anyone not feeling for the Palestinian people is "not human." The match saw Lionel Messi inspire a late comeback for Argentina after missing a penalty. Online debate emerged regarding controversial decisions and bias claims against Argentina and FIFA, though no evidence was presented. Fans in Calcutta and the USA expressed disappointment over the missed semi-final showdown.
